scope: Molex-family side-entry reference, not exact Zero 2 production geometry
notes: All assumed_* values are modelling hypotheses, not supplier measurements.
Width uses drawing D as a hypothesis for the throat; its free clearance is unconfirmed.
Contact depth inferred as 2.5 minus 1.35 mm; registration of drawing datums to open mouth is a hypothesis.
Feed stops nominally 0.05 mm short of the assumed backstop; no seating claim.
Spring-loaded rigid noses approximate contacts; no beam FEA or latch preload model.
Revision 2 replaces the artificial square contact front with a tapered convex nose; bevel dimensions remain assumptions.
PhysX default convex minimum thickness is 1 mm in this runtime; explicitly set 10 micrometres to preserve the 100 micrometre contact nose.
Revision 4 uses analytic ramp/land boxes: convex cooking still produced adjacent-contact collisions after lowering minimum thickness. No contact-neighbour collision filtering is used.
